reviews.text: Angnia is a very professional cat groomer. I recently had my 7 year badly matted cat groomed.He is not a very easy cat to deal with but Angnia was very patient and caring and got the job done.We are very grateful to her an Chico our cat is in much better form.
Excellent professional groomer. Very good with cats

Update review 17 Aug 26.  Agnia is amazing! Once again she was professional, friendly, prompt ... and absolutely brilliant with my 2 cats.  Sanitary and nail trim done expertly. And with firm but gentle care.  Thank you Agnia!
---
First review May 26
Agnia is absolutely wonderful. I have two mid-long fur kitties who hate being groomed or having their nails clipped. Agnia manages both services on both kitties quickly, effectively, and with minimum stress. When the kitties start showing their annoyance, she deals with them so calmly, and with kindness and care, until the job is done. And then she cleans up the evidence quickly and thoroughly.  I think she's amazing. Thank you Agnia! We think you are amazing.

Did a wonderful job dealing with my very scared cat when having nails cut, did it so quickly and calmly. 2 vets had not been able to trim his nails so I was so happy and relieved when Agnia managed to do it, Thank you 🙏

Agnia is very good at handling our spicy ragdoll cat. She skillfully removed some difficult knots from our boy's coat without any shaving. The whole process was very smooth and quite entertaining too because Agnia is very funny. 😆

We recommend Agnija to any kitty out there who needs some TLC! Such care and patience with our little very furry 19 year old Lily! Not an easy job as Lily is all skin and bones but can’t groom herself anymore so her fur was very matted, but Agnija took such time and care to make sure her coat was silky smooth again.
Thank u Agnia for attending today to groom Molly.  She is so soft and clean & seems happier within in herself.  No long claws to catch in bedding fabrics etc.  Excellent outcome.  Mags.
Very professional and friendly, Agnia handled our cats so well. Definitely recommend!

I had such a great experience with this pet groomer! My cat had really heavy matting and I was quite worried, but she handled everything so gently and professionally. She gave him a lion cut and did such an amazing job, he looks so much more comfortable, clean, and well cared for now. You can really tell she puts a lot of care and attention into what she does. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend her to anyone looking for a reliable and kind groomer!

Agnia is the most amazing cat groomer!!. Always have agnia seeing to my cat and giving him a lion cut..true professional and tidy..does such an amazing job.  Highly recimmend this lady..thank you agnia

Amazing service, was so friendly and made me and my cats feel at ease, highly recommend.
Thank you so much.
Does not respond to enquiries
Honestly she's the best!!! my cats adore her, and she's very patient and lovely with cats!

Agnia is fantastic. I think she is some sort of cat whisperer!! My cat has never sat on anyone lap and let them brush him!! I was amazed how thorough she is. Great ,affordable, knowledgeable and professional services. And she is a lovely funny person. Will 100% using again. Thank you so much agnia.

Unreliable. Was due to come to groom my cat at 2pm and an hour before said she had a hospital appointment? I wish the NHS offered hospital appointments at such short notice! I suggested she came after explaining I had taken a day WFH at an inconvenience to me and held my frustrated cat in all day. She declined saying ‘Sorry I don't know what time I will finish, is hospital appoitment just leave it today’. She has finally followed up after chasing and explained she isn’t available for sometime (undefined) and I should find another groomer. I echo her suggestion and recommend others do the same.
Agnija was wonderful with my two cats & would highly recommend her.  Great communication & such a lovely lady. Thank you so much.

Agnia, really is a cat whisperer my cat so we'll behaved and calm with her. When I tried to brush him he won't have it.
I di recommend her for a home visit. Thanks Agnia for today.

Agnia is a very pleasant and kind person who conducts herself professionally and most efficiently! I'm lucky to have chosen her service for clipping my cat's claws and will certainly be a regular client going forward ☺️

Excellent and quick service! I also really appreciate how friendly they were to my cat and treated him with lots of care ❤️

10/10 would recommend!

Agnia visited our house for our beloved ragdoll Aura grooming session.
Her coat was really matted and she doesn’t really like being brushed or manipulated, but Agnia remained calm and made the whole process so smooth and quick.
My cat was completely fine straight after and her coat now is the best it’s ever been.
I’d definitely recommend her and we’ll be happily use Agnia’s service for the future 🐾

Agnia was just the best, clearly knows what she's doing and is so knowledgeable. My cat was handled perfectly, the right balance of keeping her controlled but allowing my cat wiggle room so she wasn't really freaked out. Due to her professionalism, knowledge and experience the whole thing was such an easy process.....FAR better than I ever expected. Thank you so much and will absolutely book again and yes she is so much happier now she's been groomed.

Agnia is amazing so friendly, happy and gentle. She made my cat Milo feel so calm whilst she gave him a lion cut. Milo had really heavy mats and she recommended that the best thing to do was to shave him. Milo had never been professionally groomed before and she was wonderful with him. He was calm, didn’t bite or scratch her. I can’t recommend Agnia enough. Great service and left my place clean and tidy.

Agnia did a fantastic job trimming our new cat‘s nails. He probably never had this done before, so safe to say he wasn’t a big fan, but she did a great & patient job, and he’s now much happier! Will definitely get him groomed by Agnia again. Thank you!
Agnia was amazing, she dealt with my cat perfectly. She is super kind and has a lovely energy! Thansk Agnia from Katerina and Princess :)
Agnia is very professional and very good with pets. She trimmed our cat and there were no issues. Would highly recommend her. Thanks Agnia.

Not straight and simple, says on website cat grooming which is basically bathing the cat owner states she doesn’t wash cats and further tells me depends on how dirty the cat is again that is not stated on website just states what service she provides I was surprised she asked how dirty the cat was so basically she is not simple to talk too and the services on her website differs when you actually talk to her.
Really great service, put my cat Daisy at ease, very professional.

Great service good price's.
We have two very timid easily frightened cats. Trying to go to vets for grooming or claws clipped is a nightmare. This lady came to our house approx 15 mins later both cats claws clipped.
Wonderful job thank you
One of the best groomer ❤️

Agnia was incredible! Communicative from the moment I messaged up until the end of the groom. She was very patient with my cat and ensured I felt comfortable with each step of the process. My ragdoll is extremely fluffy and needed to be shaven down due to temperature change as well as maintenance and Agnia ensured my needs were met (before and after picture provided). I cannot thank her enough and we will definitely be seeing her again :)
